userStories.title: Bootstrap — docker compose services profile, broker+gateway sandbox path
userStories.userStory: As Ralph I need the full stack up with MCP_STDIO_IN_PROCESS=false before adversarial testing.
acceptanceCriteria: docker compose --profile services up -d brings mcp-broker + gateway + control + frontend
curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8300/health or gateway health endpoint returns 200

userStories.title: Org-alpha adversarial harness — 5+ stdio MCP servers
userStories.userStory: As security I need org-alpha running 5+ distinct stdio MCP servers in its sandbox.
acceptanceCriteria: 5+ stdio servers registered; tools/list returns distinct tool sets per server

userStories.title: Org-beta adversarial harness — 5+ stdio MCP servers

userStories.title: Parallel 2-agent iteration runner (org-alpha + org-beta)
userStories.userStory: As Ralph each iteration MUST run 2 parallel org agents before marking any story pass.
acceptanceCriteria: Each worker: own org, 5+ MCP servers, tools/list + tools/call

userStories.title: Backend adversarial pytest suite scaffold
userStories.userStory: As CI I need pytest adversarial probes runnable without the frontend.
acceptanceCriteria: Covers denylist, volume isolation, escape probes
Gate: cd gateway && ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest ai_mesh_gateway/tests/test_mcp_sandbox_adversarial.py -q -k 'not docker' OR full docker gate when Docker available

userStories.title: Cross-org leakage probes (volume, env, npm cache bleed)
userStories.userStory: As security no org may read another org's volume, env markers, or shared cache secrets.
acceptanceCriteria: test_npm_cache_bleed_probe — sibling org marker absent in get_env

userStories.title: Sandbox escape attempts (path traversal, /proc, docker.sock)
userStories.userStory: As security adversarial MCP payloads must not escape the sandbox container.

userStories.title: Frontend Playwright — MCPConnectorPanel 5+ stdio servers per org
